gi = GalaxyInstance(url='https://usegalaxy.org', key=open('/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key').read().strip())

                print(f'  Copied: {item[\"name\"]} (hid={item[\"hid\"]}, id={item[\"id\"]})')
            except Exception as e:
                print(f'  Failed to copy {item[\"name\"]}: {e}')
" 2>&1
